verdict.rationale: Vanta has a dedicated Trust Center product page claiming it automates time-consuming security reviews and gives prospects the information they need to make a purchase decision. That covers the story's core intent, but the evidence is a single high-level marketing statement with no detail on what the trust center actually contains or how it is shared. Missing for 10: evidence of live/real-time control status display, certification and report hosting, click-through NDA gating for document access, hosted public page details, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
